scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello there~!
How'd you like to
participate in Kafra
Corporation's special
^529DFFBunny Band Event^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您好~！
您想參加卡普拉公司
舉辦的特別
^529DFF兔耳髮圈活動^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Alrighty~
Let me check to
see if you brought
all the items...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
好的~
讓我看看
您是否帶齊了
所有材料...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Ooh, I'm sorry
but you need to
bring at least
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
哎呀，很抱歉，
您至少還需要
{0}。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Great, I see that
you've gathered
everything I need to
make the Bunny Band.
Please wait a moment
while I put it together...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
太好了，看來
您已經集齊了
製作兔耳髮圈
所需的所有材料。
請稍等，
讓我來為您製作...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hm? I'm sorry,
but I actually can't
make this right now. You
need {0}
in order for me to put this
Bunny Band together...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
嗯？很抱歉，
我現在還無法為您製作。
您需要{0}
我才能為您製作兔耳髮圈...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Ah, here you go~
The perfect Bunny Band!
Well, I hope you enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
啊，給您~
完美的兔耳髮圈！
希望您能喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you for
participating in this
special event and your
continued patronage
of the Kafra Services~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
感謝您參加
這次特別活動，
也感謝您一直以來
對卡普拉服務的支援~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hi there~! Would you like
to join our special ^529DFFBunny
Band Event^000000 hosted by the Kafra
Corporation and sponsored by
the Alberta Merchant Guild?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您好~！您想參加
由卡普拉公司主辦、
艾爾貝塔商人公會贊助的
特別^529DFF兔耳髮圈活動^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Great! Thanks for
participating! If you
haven't already heard,
you need to collect these
items if you want me put a
Bunny Band together for you...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
太好了！
感謝您的參與！
如果您還沒聽說，
如果您想讓我為您製作兔耳髮圈，
您需要收集以下材料...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
100 Feathers,
1 Four-Leaf Clover,
1 Kitty Band and
1 Pearl. That's it!
Good luck and I'll be
waiting for you here~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
100個羽毛，
1個四葉幸運草，
1個貓耳髮圈
和1個珍珠。就是這些！
祝您好運，
我會在這裡等您~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
To thank our valued
customers, Kafra Corporation
has prepared a special event
where Kafra Employee will assemble
Bunny Bands for adventurers
who bring the required items.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
為了感謝我們的
尊貴顧客，卡普拉公司
準備了一場特別活動，
卡普拉 職員將為
帶來所需材料的冒險者
製作兔耳髮圈。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
For this special,
one of a kind item,
bring 100 Feathers,
1 Four-Leaf Clover,
1 Kitty Band and
1 Pearl.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
為了這個
獨一無二的特別物品，
請帶來100個羽毛，
1個四葉幸運草，
1個貓耳髮圈
和1個珍珠。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you're ready,
come back and bring
those items to me.
(Sponsored by the
Alberta Merchant Guild).
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
當您準備好後，
請帶著這些材料
回來找我。
（由艾爾貝塔商人公會贊助）
